skill.name: writing-tests
skill.description: Guides AI assistants to write concise, maintainable backend tests using fixtures and shared setup helpers.
skill.summary: Backend testing guidance for concise cases, reusable fixtures, and maintainable setup.
skill.author: Crossbill-Highlights

security_audit.summary: The static finding is a false positive caused by benign prose about test fixtures and helper functions. No prompt injection, data access, network behavior, or executable code was found in SKILL.md.

static_findings.snippet: - When tests need setup, use fixtures and functions to avoid repeating same steps in multiple tests.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 7 gives safe guidance to reuse fixtures and helper functions in tests. It does not request system reconnaissance, privileged access, or any executable action.

content.value_statement: Backend tests can become long, repetitive, and hard to maintain. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward concise tests with shared fixtures.
actual_capabilities: Guides backend test writing toward comprehensive coverage.
Recommends fixtures for common test data.
Promotes helper functions for repeated setup steps.
limitations: Provides general guidance, not framework-specific commands.
Does not define assertion patterns or mocking strategy.
Does not cover frontend testing workflows.
Does not include runnable test examples.

use_cases.title: Improve backend test reviews
use_cases.description: Use the skill to check whether new backend tests are concise and maintainable.

use_cases.title: Plan test fixture cleanup
use_cases.description: Use the guidance to identify repeated setup steps that should become fixtures or helpers.

use_cases.title: Standardize team testing habits
use_cases.description: Use the skill as a lightweight rule set for consistent backend test structure.

prompt_templates.title: Review one backend test
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this backend test for length, setup duplication, and fixture opportunities. Suggest practical improvements.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single test case

prompt_templates.title: Refactor repeated setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Find repeated setup steps in these backend tests. Recommend fixtures or helper functions that keep each test short.

prompt_templates.title: Design a test structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Help design maintainable backend test coverage for this feature. Include fixture needs and concise test case boundaries.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a test suite
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this backend test suite for maintainability. Prioritize duplicated setup, overlong tests, and missing coverage areas.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of a larger suite

output_examples.input: Review a backend test with repeated user creation setup.
output_examples.output: The test should move repeated user creation into a fixture. Keep the test focused on the behavior being asserted.

output_examples.input: Plan tests for a new backend endpoint.
output: List key success and failure paths.
Create shared fixtures for common request data.
Keep each test focused on one observable outcome.

best_practices: Keep each backend test focused on one behavior.
Use fixtures for common test data.
Move repeated setup steps into clear helper functions.
anti_patterns: Writing long tests that mix setup, action, and many outcomes.
Copying the same setup steps across many tests.
Adding broad tests without checking maintainability.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code apply simple backend testing guidelines.

faq.question: Does it include runnable tests?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance for writing and reviewing backend tests.

faq.question: Which testing frameworks does it support?
faq.answer: It is framework-neutral and focuses on test structure, fixtures, and maintainability.

faq.question: Can it improve existing tests?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide reviews that find long tests and repeated setup.

faq.question: Is it only for unit tests?
faq.answer: No. The guidance can apply to backend unit, integration, and service tests.

faq.question: Does it require special tools?
faq.answer: No. The skill is a short instruction file and does not run scripts.
